CL-12
CLUTCH - CLUTCH RELEASE CYUNDER
REASSEMBLY
1. INSTALL BLEEDER PLUG
Torque: 8.4 N•m (85 kgf.cm, 74 in.•lbf)
2. COAT PISTON WITH LITHIUM SOAP BASE GLYCOL
GREASE, AS SHOWN
3. INSTALL PISTON AND SPRING INTO CYLINDER
4. INSTALL BOOT ANO PUSH ROD
(a) Install the push rod to the boot.
{b) Install the boot with the push rod to the cylinder.
